_note: What a skill is trying to do, in 15 purposes. A skill gets one primary purpose: (1) an entry in `names`, else (2) the first purpose whose `name_rx` matches the skill's name, else (3) its home cluster's entry in `cluster_purpose`: a fixed purpose, or `by_phase` with a default, in which case the skill's strongest job (the hive's phase scores) picks the purpose through `phase_purpose`, and the default is used when the skill's words name no job. Up to two secondary purposes come from the skill's other clusters and its second-strongest job.

purposes.name: Design interfaces
purposes.description: Make interfaces look and feel right: visual style, components, motion and accessibility.

purposes.name: Build features
purposes.description: Write the code: frameworks, languages, APIs, data and integrations.

purposes.name: Test and verify
purposes.description: Write tests and check that things work.

purposes.name: Debug and fix
purposes.description: Find the cause of a failure and repair it.

purposes.name: Secure and audit
purposes.description: Find and close security holes; privacy and compliance.

purposes.name: Review and refactor
purposes.description: Review changes, enforce quality and clean up code.

purposes.name: Speed up and cut cost
purposes.description: Make it faster, smaller or cheaper, including tokens.

purposes.name: Deploy and release
purposes.description: Ship it: containers, CI, infrastructure and releases.

purposes.name: Plan and architect
purposes.description: Decide what to build and how: plans, specs, architecture and decisions.

purposes.name: Research and understand
purposes.description: Learn a codebase, a topic or a market before acting.

purposes.name: Run agents and workflows
purposes.description: Orchestrate agents, loops, automations, memory and gateways.

purposes.name: Build skills, plugins and MCP
purposes.description: Extend the agent itself: skills, plugins, hooks and MCP servers.

purposes.name: Create content, media and 3D
purposes.description: Produce writing, video, social posts, Blender scenes and other media.

purposes.name: Run the business
purposes.description: Finance, operations, planning for teams, industry work and careers.
